hypothesis: Checking approved context before clarification reduces redundant questions without suppressing necessary questions.
proposed_mechanism: Add a bounded context-check procedure before requirements clarification.
applies_when: An agent is about to ask for information that may already be confirmed in its authorized workspace.
does_not_apply_when: Information is missing, contradictory, outdated, or explicitly requires reconfirmation.
risks: Retrieval could add latency or consult stale context.

target.ownership_rationale: Illustrative only: this target assumes code inspection establishes that the shared kit owns the relevant context-check behavior.

development_cases: Confirmed information is reused instead of requested again.
negative_cases: Unauthorized workspace context is never retrieved.
